_comment: US Federal Reserve / OCC / FDIC regional governance thresholds. The domains.finance overlay states the CTRL_AGT_001 trade confidence floor; every other finance threshold equals the global value in config/governance_thresholds.json. To activate: set CAGE_DEPLOYMENT_REGION=US_FED

finance._comment: Regional overlay of domains.finance in config/governance_thresholds.json, deep-merged at threshold load for CAGE_DEPLOYMENT_REGION=US_FED (src/gateway/governance/schemas/regional_overlay.py) and validated by the finance schema (src/cage_finance/thresholds.py) at governor assembly. Keys omitted here inherit the global value.

confidence._comment: [CTRL_AGT_001] Minimum agentic model confidence required to execute a trade. ISO 42001 §A.5.2 primary; SR 26-2 §IV.B legacy citation. Conservative threshold for US Federal Reserve supervised entities; equal to the universal confidence band floor, so the trade_confidence tier adds no constraint in this region.
